# Checklist

- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits (e.g., `feat:`, `fix:`) and do not mix
  unrelated changes.
- [ ] Locale files keep the existing key structure and ordering. If multiple
  locale files change (e.g., `en` and `ja`), each key is updated consistently
  across them.
- [ ] No sensitive or secret information is in the commits.
